corporation_name.rationale: Corporation legal name is a header-level filer identity element not present in the closed candidate list extracted from the MeF stylesheet.

ein.rationale: EIN is a filer identity attribute not present among the closed candidate list elements.

address.rationale: Street address is a filer identity element not present in the candidate list; canonical schema splits address into multiple sub-elements (AddressLine1Txt, CityNm, StateAbbreviationCd, ZIPCd) none of which appear in this candidate list.

city.rationale: City is a filer identity element not present in the candidate list.

state.rationale: State abbreviation is a filer identity element not present in the candidate list.

zip_code.rationale: ZIP code is a filer identity element not present in the candidate list.

tax_year_begin.rationale: Tax year begin date is a return-header attribute not present in the closed candidate list.

tax_year_end.rationale: Tax year end date is a return-header attribute not present in the closed candidate list.

date_incorporated.rationale: IncorporationDt directly maps to the date of incorporation field on page 1.

state_of_incorporation.rationale: State of incorporation is not present among the closed candidate list elements.

business_activity_code.rationale: Principal Business Activity code is not present among the closed candidate list elements.

business_activity.rationale: Business activity description is not present among the closed candidate list elements.

product_or_service.rationale: Product or service description is not present among the closed candidate list elements.

initial_return.rationale: InitialReturnInd directly maps to the 'Initial return' checkbox on page 1.

final_return.rationale: FinalReturnInd directly maps to the 'Final return' checkbox on page 1.

name_change.rationale: NameChangeInd directly maps to the 'Name change' checkbox on page 1.

address_change.rationale: AddressChangeInd directly maps to the 'Address change' checkbox on page 1.

amended_return.rationale: AmendedReturnInd directly maps to the 'Amended return' checkbox on page 1.

gross_receipts_or_sales.rationale: GrossReceiptsOrSalesAmt maps to line 1a gross receipts or sales.

returns_and_allowances.rationale: ReturnsAndAllowancesAmt maps to line 1b returns and allowances.

net_receipts_or_sales.rationale: NetGrossReceiptsOrSalesAmt maps to line 1c net receipts or sales (1a minus 1b).

cost_of_goods_sold.rationale: CostOfGoodsSoldAmt maps to line 2 cost of goods sold carried from Schedule A.

gross_profit.rationale: GrossProfitAmt maps to line 3 gross profit.

interest_income.rationale: TaxableInterestAmt maps to line 5 taxable interest income.

gross_rents.rationale: GrossRentsAmt maps to line 6 gross rents.

gross_royalties.rationale: GrossRoyaltiesAmt maps to line 7 gross royalties.

capital_gain_net_income.rationale: CapitalGainNetIncomeAmt maps to line 8 capital gain net income from Schedule D.

net_gain_loss_form_4797.rationale: TotalOrdinaryGainLossAmt maps to line 9 net gain or loss from Form 4797.

other_income.rationale: OtherIncomeAmt maps to line 10 other income.

total_income.rationale: TotalIncomeAmt maps to line 11 total income (sum of lines 3–10).

compensation_of_officers.rationale: OfficersCompensationAmt maps to line 12 compensation of officers from Schedule E.

salaries_and_wages.rationale: SalariesAndWagesAmt maps to line 13 salaries and wages.

repairs_and_maintenance.rationale: RepairsAndMaintenanceAmt maps to line 14 repairs and maintenance.

bad_debts.rationale: BadDebtExpenseAmt maps to line 15 bad debts.

rents.rationale: TotalRentOrLeaseExpenseAmt maps to line 16 rent expense.

taxes_and_licenses.rationale: TaxesAndLicensesAmt maps to line 17 taxes and licenses.

interest_expense.rationale: InterestDeductionAmt maps to line 18 interest expense.

charitable_contributions.rationale: CharitableContributionsTotAmt maps to line 19 charitable contributions.

depreciation.rationale: DepreciationAmt maps to line 20 depreciation from Form 4562.

pension_profit_sharing_plans.rationale: PensionProfitSharingPlansAmt maps to line 23 pension and profit-sharing plan contributions.

employee_benefit_programs.rationale: EmployeeBenefitProgramAmt maps to line 24 employee benefit programs.

other_deductions.rationale: OtherDeductionsAmt maps to the other deductions line (line 26 or equivalent) on page 1.

total_deductions.rationale: TotalDeductionAmt maps to the total deductions line on page 1.

taxable_income_before_nol.rationale: TaxableIncomeBfrNOLSpclDedAmt maps to taxable income before NOL and special deductions.

nol_deduction.rationale: NetOperatingLossDeductionAmt maps to the NOL deduction line on page 1.

special_deductions.rationale: TotalSpecialDeductionsAmt maps to the special deductions line from Schedule C.

taxable_income.rationale: TaxableIncomeAmt maps to line 30 taxable income after NOL and special deductions.

credit_form_4136.rationale: Credit from Form 4136 is not present among the closed candidate list elements.

total_payments.rationale: TotalPaymentsAndCreditsAmt maps to the total payments and refundable credits line.

estimated_tax_penalty.rationale: EsPenaltyAmt maps to the estimated tax penalty (§6655) line.

tax_due.rationale: BalanceDueAmt maps to the tax due / amount owed line.

overpayment.rationale: OverpaymentAmt under OverpaymentSection maps to the overpayment line.
